title: Lock Fee Accounting Note: Upfront Fee Held and Extension Pricing
content:
The upfront fee a buyer has paid and Calloway Home Mortgage still holds on a Builder Extended Rate Lock earns a credit against the extension fee percent.

**Rule.** The upfront fee held is the lock fee payments on the lock ledger less refunds, forfeitures and credits of that fee. An upfront fee held of at least twice the term's minimum extension fee takes 0.03125 percentage points off the extension fee percent; an upfront fee held above zero but less than that takes 0.015625 percentage points off; none takes nothing off. The points are taken off the extension fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

## Thresholds by term

| Lock term | Minimum extension fee | Twice the minimum (full credit threshold) |
|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | USD 150.00 | USD 300.00 |
| 90-Day Lock | USD 150.00 | USD 300.00 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | USD 250.00 | USD 500.00 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | USD 250.00 | USD 500.00 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | USD 350.00 | USD 700.00 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | USD 350.00 | USD 700.00 |

## Credit bands

| Upfront fee held | Taken off |
|---|---|
| at least twice the term's minimum extension fee | 0.03125 percentage points |
| above zero, below twice the minimum | 0.015625 percentage points |
| zero | nothing |

## Example (hypothetical ledger)

A 180-Day Extended Lock ledger with lock fee payments of USD 1000.00 and USD 500.00 and a refund of USD 1100.00: fee held USD 400.00, above zero but below USD 500.00, so 0.015625 points come off. Without the refund the fee held is USD 1500.00 and 0.03125 points come off.
